answer: What I'd try is reserving two seats on every five-seat panel for veterans, accounts with 30+ epochs and at least 80% of their grades matching final verdicts. The other three stay open to anyone. If both veterans vote against the newcomer majority, nothing settles and a fresh panel gets drawn. Say a farm wants a sloppy ridge trail atlas passed. It can forge a hundred accounts in an afternoon, but each veteran it needs costs a week of honest grading first. New honest graders still get most of the seats.
